name: cursor-usage-monorepo
description: Cursor usage dashboard: shared TypeScript core + UI for the desktop app and the Cursor extension

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build && npm run build -w cursor-usage
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && npm run package -w cursor-usage
